{{Infobox/Character |quests = {{Quest|Safety First}} |shop = Yes |abiphone = Yes |location = [[Community Center]] |location_page_description = Allows the player to learn about [[City Projects]] or purchase [[Fire Sales]], [[Account & Profile Upgrades]], and {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s. |x= -6.25 |y= 79 |z= 19.25 }} '''Elizabeth''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Community Center}}. To access her associated features, players must be at least {{SkyBlock Level|3}}. == Usage == {{Main|City Projects|Fire Sales|Account & Profile Upgrades|Booster Cookie|Bits}} '''Elizabeth''' has many different features in her menu, such as the option to see the most recent and all past [[City Projects]] and [[Fire Sales]]. Another feature is the [[Account & Profile Upgrades]] menu, where players can get bonuses for them on all of their [[profiles]], such as more {{Stat|MF}} and [[Ender Chest]] pages. The player can also get bonuses for all their co-op members on one profile, some for free (like [[Minion|Minion Slots]], some costing {{Gems}} such as [[Co-op|Co-op slots]]. Another menu allows players to receive {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for free and then purchase additional ones for {{Gems}}. The user can buy {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=1}} for {{Gems|325}}, {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=6}}s for {{Gems|1950}}, or {{Item|Booster Cookie|amount=12}}s for {{Gems|3900}}. In her menu is also located the Bits Shop, where players can use {{Bits}}, obtained using {{Item|Booster Cookie}}s, to purchase various items. Most notably, the player can buy a {{Item|God Potion}} for {{Bits|1500}}, a {{Item|Kismet Feather}} for {{Bits|1350}}, {{Item|Pure Black Dye}} and {{Item|Pure White Dye}} for {{Bits|250000}}, and [[Enrichments]] for {{Bits|5000}} Her last menu lists the 5 commonly available [[Ranks]] on Hypixel and their perks: {{Rank|VIP}}, {{Rank|VIP+}}, {{Rank|MVP}}, {{Rank|MVP+}}, and {{Rank|MVP++}}. Furthermore, there is an item at the bottom of this page, as well as other pages, displaying your current {{Gems}}, {{Bits}}, and [[Fame Ranks|Fame Rank]]. After completing {{NPCSprite|Brigette}}'s account security quest, she gives the player a free {{Item|Booster Cookie}}. == Interface == {{Outdated|section=yes}} {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Below SkyBlock Level 3 |{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &dElizabeth&f: Hello! I hope you enjoy using it! }} |} == Account and Profile Upgrades == {{Outdated|{{Changelog|2026/April 8}} Changes to Skyblock Gem bundles resulting in an increase of cost}} These upgrades can be applied to either your current profile or your entire account. Some upgrades are free, while others require SkyBlock Gems to unlock. Each upgrade takes a certain amount of time to complete, but you can use SkyBlock Gems to skip the waiting. To fully upgrade everything to the maximum level, a player will need '''6,050 SkyBlock Gems'''. The total waiting time is '''382 real-world days''' for profile upgrades and '''244 days''' for account upgrades. You can choose to spend an additional '''80,904 SkyBlock Gems''' to skip the waiting period entirely. The cost will depend on the current value of SkyBlock Gems. ==== Upgrades per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.49 |93.46 gems/$ |9 |6,300 |'''$67.41''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.74 |96.05 gems/$ |4 |7200 |'''$73.96''' |- |3 |3,750 |$37.49 |100.03 gems/$ |2 |7,500 |'''$74.98''' |- |4 |7,600 |$74.99 |101.35 gems/$ |1 |7,600 |'''$74.99''' |- |5 |17,000 |$149.99 |113.34 gems/$ |1 |17,000 |'''$149.99''' |} The best option is to buy 3 '''× 1,800 packs + 1 × 700 pack''' for a total of '''6,100 Gems''' at a cost of '''$61,67''' — but only if you plan to upgrade without skipping the waiting time. ==== Skipping time per tier of gems bought: ==== {| class="wikitable" !Option !Bundle !Bundle Price !Gems per Pack !Packs Needed !Total Gems !Total Cost |- |1 |700 |$7.25 |96.55 gems/$ |116 |81,200 |'''$841.00''' |- |2 |1,800 |$18.14 |99.23 gems/$ |45 |81,000 |'''$816.30''' |- |3 |3,750 |$36,29 |103.33 gems/$ |22 |82,500 |'''$798.38''' |- |4 |7,600 |$72.59 |104.70 gems/$ |11 |83,600 |'''$798.49''' |- |5 |17,000 |$145.19 |117.09 gems/$ |5 |85,000 |'''$725.95''' |} '''The best option''', '''considering''' you need the previous gems to upgrade and skip the waiting time, is to buy: 4 '''× 17,000 packs + 1 × 7,600 pack + 1 × 3,750 pack + 1 × 1,800 pack for a total of 6,300 Gems''' at a cost of '''$707.78'''. == Trivia == *The patch notes for the [https://hypixel.net/threads/5692280/ Better Mayors update] claim that "'''Elizabeth''' was too stubborn to move, so she is staying at the same location". Despite this claim, she actually moved 4 blocks. *On the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]], the Community Shop requires {{SBL|10}} instead of {{SBL|3}}. *When '''Elizabeth''' says "That's rough, buddy." during the Security Safety Quest; it appears to be a reference to Prince Zuko from ATLA. == Gallery == Elizabeth Scene.png|'''Elizabeth''' as seen in the Community Center. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|2026/March 23|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} |beta= {{History|0.9|[[File:Elizabeth.png|26px]] Added '''Elizabeth'''.}} {{History|0.15|Changed '''Elizabeth'''{{'}}s dialogue from saying to go to the {{zone|Deep Caverns}} to talking about [[SkyBlock Levels]] if the player doesn't have access to the shop.}} {{History|0.16|Added [[Abiphones#Contacts|{{Aqua|Abiphone Contact}}]].}} {{History|2023/June 21|Fixed the city project button being empty when calling '''Elizabeth''' through an [[Abiphone]].}} {{history|0.19.1|Fixed Community Shop profile upgrade history not displaying the right player names.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved '''Elizabeth''' from {{Coords|-3.5|72|-101.5}} to {{Coords|-6.25|79|19.25}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} {{History|0.24.3|Abiphone Contact reworked - no longer requires [[Abiphone Contacts Trio]] and enables being called whenever Account & Profile Upgrade finishes or a FIRE Sale starts.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
